d: New US Foreign Agents Registration Act (FARA) filings have revealed that SHW Partners LLC, a lobbying firm headed by Donald Trump aide Jason Miller, arranged eight phone calls between senior White House officials and the Indian government in May and June 2026. The calls, listed as discussions on India-US relations, involved senior officials including US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Deputy National Security Adviser Michael Needham and US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer. India had hired Miller's firm in April 2025 at a monthly fee of $150,000, renewing the contract for another year…
